title: Step 6: what you built
description:
You built a complete game from state, a few small functions and a loop. Look back over your code: each function does one job, and its name says which. That is the shape most good programs have, from games to apps.

Ideas to try on your own: pick the secret at random from an array with words.randomElement(), show the wrong letters guessed so far, or draw a simple picture as the lives run out.

questions.question: Why does guess turn the letter into uppercase first?

answers.text: Sets can only hold capital letters
So "w" and "W" count as the same guess

questions.why: The secret is in capitals, so guesses are made to match.

questions.question: Why is guessed a Set and not an array?

answers.text: Each letter only needs to be stored once, and checking it is fast

questions.why: Sets hold unique values and have fast contains.

answers.text: Leaves the loop, so no more guesses are made after the game ends
